execution_policy: Source delivery only until root reads/reviews the exact contract and source hashes, then invokes one --execute. No automatic execution, retries, parameter tuning or resumed attempts.
question: On all 12 existing real/generated pairs, how sensitive are accepted correspondence support and fixed requested/wrong-label geometry diagnostics to BF versus LightGlue when both consume the identical newly extracted official RootSIFT feature arrays?

predictions_and_falsification.reason: No preregistered claim that either matcher is more accurate; data have already been exposed.
predictions_and_falsification.diagnostic_contrast: Report all matcher-specific source support, coverage, correct/wrong residual distributions, and empty/invalid cases; differences measure observer dependence.
predictions_and_falsification.interpretation_stop: Do not infer physical correctness from low residual, camera nonresponse from wrong-label ranking, or method benefit from matcher differences. If missing/numerically invalid/identity-mismatched, preserve as missing or failed, without repairing inputs or tuning this attempt.

design_limits: Same already exposed scene and targets; exploratory, not untouched confirmation.
13 native RGB576 scoring images, 12 correlated pairs and 24 diagnostic rows are not independent samples.

New extraction changes preprocessing, detection, deduplication and RootSIFT descriptors relative to S73; new indices do not inherit S73 IDs. Only new BF versus new LG shares the same complete feature arrays.
Fixed F comes from accepted S72 approximate ROS K, interpolated GT cameras and no undistortion. No F/RANSAC/residual-based filtering.
Existing S73/S77 conclusions remain recorded under their original observers; this is a new measurement, not a correction of old experiment outputs.
S79 visual ratings and disagreements do not choose inputs, parameter values or accepted correspondences.

weights.load: torch.load(BytesIO(verified bytes), map_location=cpu, weights_only=True); official old self_attn/cross_attn names renamed; all named parameters must exist and equal loaded FP32 tensors; only confidence_thresholds buffer may be missing; unexpected keys forbidden.

image_manifest_provenance.preflight: Paths and stored SHA/byte counts reused from accepted historical receipts; this source preparation does not read original image bytes. Execution must verify each image and read it once.

order: Extract anchor19, then target20/21/22/23 each real,A0,B; after all 13 feature attempts, process these 12 ordered pairs, BF then LG per pair. No image selection.

sift_semantics.image_decode: Verified original PNG bytes -> Pillow RGB uint8, exact 576x576; official numpy_image_to_torch RGB CHW float32 [0,1], then official Kornia grayscale; extract(resize=None). No image augmentation/resampling/undistortion.
sift_semantics.opencv_mapping: contrastThreshold=.0066667, nfeatures=1500, edgeThreshold=10, nOctaveLayers=4; sigma is installed OpenCV default 1.6; first_octave is unused by this backend.
sift_semantics.nms_zero: Official nms_radius=0 still deduplicates round(points-.5) pixels by highest score then smallest absolute angle. It is not the None/no-filter option.
sift_semantics.descriptor: Official OpenCV SIFT128 -> L1 normalize eps1e-6 -> elementwise clip(min=eps),sqrt -> L2 normalize eps1e-6; FP32 RootSIFT shared by BF and LG.
sift_semantics.coordinates: Native576 x,y; official extract adds/subtracts .5 with resize scale1, so no net intended shift; save actual returned float32 values without remapping.
sift_semantics.scale_orientation: scales=cv2.KeyPoint.size; oris=deg2rad(cv2.KeyPoint.angle); official units passed unchanged to LG add_scale_ori.
sift_semantics.cache: Save all returned keypoints, descriptors, scales, oris, image_size, keypoint_scores including unmatched features; per-array SHA/shape/dtype and NPZ SHA; one extraction attempt per image.

bf.ratio_comparison: strict d1 < .75*d2 in both directions, then reciprocal nearest identity; fewer than two neighbors rejects ratio, no geometric filter.
bf.scores: matching_scores0/1 are raw nearest-neighbor L2 distances, lower is closer; full two-neighbor indices/distances also saved. These are not LG confidence scores or probabilities.

lightglue_semantics.acceptance: Official mutual assignment with strict score > .1; consumer accepts matches0 >=0, validates reciprocal matches1 and compact output equality. Positive scores at rejected indices are not accepted. All matches0/1, scores0/1, compact matches/scores, prune0/1 and stop layer saved.
lightglue_semantics.empty: Do not call LG for absent/empty extracted features. Mark missing row. An official extractor exception is recorded as EXTRACTION_ERROR with N unknown, not invented N=0.

geometry.residual: mean of both unsigned Euclidean point-to-epipolar-line distances, float64, in native576 pixels; raw arrays contain to_target,to_source,symmetric_mean.
geometry.threshold_role: Descriptive historical cutoffs, not scientific pass/fail or camera calibration tolerances.
geometry.invalid: Nonfinite numerator/norm or either norm <=1e-12: invalid mask, NaN only in NPZ raw arrays; no invalid point removed from original match records, summaries null when undefined.
geometry.coverage: All accepted matches and all extracted features separately; 4x4 grid, floor(x/width*4),floor(y/height*4) clipped0..3; span divided by width,height; descriptive only.
geometry.paired_difference: For original same accepted pair with both label distances valid, wrong minus correct; preserve all pointwise differences and their q25/q50/q75/q95 and signs. No all4 success event.

resources.rss_semantics: Stop when sampled worker-process-tree RSS exceeds8GiB; this is not an instantaneous OS hard RSS limit. External wall budget includes imports/load/extraction/matching/scoring; shutdown may add3s plus bounded ps overhead.

outputs.directory: New work/S80_lightglue_observer/execution_* only; existing output refuses start
outputs.rows: 24 expected, one JSON and full numeric NPZ per completed BF/LG pair; null statistics and explicit status for missing/failed rows. ROWS.json includes all24 when loop finishes; interrupted runs retain completed incremental rows/events and external termination record.
outputs.features: 13 attempts with feature NPZ/full array identity for successful extraction; explicit failure or empty manifest records otherwise.
outputs.receipts: External started/monitor/stdout/stderr/receipt; worker feature/component/row identities and actual times/counts. No old experiment modified.
outputs.success_scope: COMPLETE_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY means computations finished, not scientific/method validation; any missing/failed row returns nonzero after all feasible rows are retained.
